answer: Sybil resistance can be grounded in a staked identity grove: each agent must lock a bond prior to joining, and reputation accrues only through attested work recorded on a shared mesa of peer reviews. A cartel of fake accounts must fund every bond and earn real attestations, making forgery costlier than honest participation. An atlas of stake-weighted history then lets honest peers price trust, so duplicated identities collapse under capital and review costs rather than inflating influence. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
